Based on the examples and guidelines provided, here's the SWRL rule for the given natural language rule:

```swrl
Incident(?i) ^ hasIncidentLocation(?i, ?il) ^ Dataset(?d) ^ involvedIn(?d, ?i) ^ producedBy(?d, ?t) ^ relatesToMediaItem(?t, ?m) -> hasMediaLocation(?il, ?ml) ^ beAWARE_ontology:isLocationOfMediaItem(?ml, true)
```

This rule states that if an incident (?i) has a location (?il), and this incident is involved within a dataset (?d), which was produced by a task (?t) related to a media item (?m), then the location of the incident (?il) is the same as the location of the media item (?ml). The location of the media item is represented as an instance of the class beAWARE_ontology:Location with the property beAWARE_ontology:isLocationOfMediaItem set to true.
